description: Summary figure: mug151 pLDDT profile and Pfam domain, Foldseek hit counts per database, and conservation of the experimental SAP30BP-CDK11/cyclin L interface in mug151
code:
import requests, numpy as np, collections, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

# ---- re-fetch everything needed (fresh namespace each call) ----
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q10069-F1-model_v6.pdb", headers=H, timeout=120).text
plddt={}
for l in af.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA': plddt[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
res=np.array(sorted(plddt)); vals=np.array([plddt[i] for i in res])

pdbtxt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9QKZ.pdb", headers=H, timeout=120).text
t2o=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',LEU='L',LYS='K',
         MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V')
at=collections.defaultdict(list); seqres={}
for l in pdbtxt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        ch=l[21]; rn=int(l[22:26])
        at[ch].append((rn,np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
        seqres[(ch,rn)]=t2o.get(l[17:20].strip(),'X')
Ac=np.array([c for _,c in at['A']]); Ar=np.array([r for r,_ in at['A']])
iface=set()
for part in ['B','C']:
    P=np.array([c for _,c in at[part]])
    d=np.linalg.norm(Ac[:,None,:]-P[None,:,:],axis=2)
    iface |= set(Ar[np.where((d<4.5).any(axis=1))[0]].tolist())

qAln="SFSERVRNMSPD--------EIKIPPEPPGRCSNHLQDKIQKLYERKIKEGMDMNYIIQRKKEFRNPSIYEKLIQFCAI-DELGTNYPKDMFDPHGWSEDSYYEALAKAQKIEMDKLEKA"
tAln="EEQTSLVNENNDIKGRSEEPHWKIPNSPKAEVDTELEKKIKQFIKLKA-KGIHFHTRLSENENFRNPKLLDNLQDFLDIKEPRGTMISKDMWDPTDFHKNVYASALSKSQDEMIARRENY"
qi,ti=7,11; off=97
pairs=[]
for qc,tc in zip(qAln,tAln):
    if qc!='-' and tc!='-': pairs.append((off+qi,qc,ti,tc,qc==tc)); qi+=1; ti+=1
    elif qc=='-': ti+=1
    else: qi+=1

ifa=[p for p in pairs if p[0] in iface]; nonifa=[p for p in pairs if p[0] not in iface]
a=sum(p[4] for p in ifa); b=len(ifa)-a; c=sum(p[4] for p in nonifa); d_=len(nonifa)-c
OR,pv=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d_]], alternative='greater')
print(f"Interface identity {a}/{len(ifa)} = {a/len(ifa):.1%} ; non-interface {c}/{len(nonifa)} = {c/len(nonifa):.1%}")
print(f"Fisher exact (one-sided, interface enriched for identity): OR={OR:.2f}, p={pv:.3f}")

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,1,height_ratios=[1,1,1.25],hspace=0.55)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax.plot(res,vals,color='#2b6cb0',lw=1.6)
ax.axhspan(0,50,color='#fed7d7',alpha=.5); ax.axhspan(50,70,color='#feebc8',alpha=.5)
ax.axhspan(70,90,color='#c6f6d5',alpha=.5); ax.axhspan(90,100,color='#bee3f8',alpha=.5)
ax.axvspan(34,127,color='#805ad5',alpha=.15)
ax.text(80,22,'Pfam PF07818 (HCNGP) 34-127, E = 4e-27',ha='center',fontsize=9,color='#553c9a')
ax.set_xlim(1,146); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_xlabel('mug151 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT')
ax.set_title('A. AlphaFold AF-Q10069-F1: disordered N-terminus (1-30), confident core 31-131',loc='left',fontsize=11)

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
labels=['PDB100\n(Foldseek snapshot)','AFDB SwissProt','AFDB proteome','AFDB50']
counts=[0,3,25,935]   # excluding self-hit
bars=ax2.bar(labels,counts,color=['#e53e3e','#38a169','#3182ce','#805ad5'])
ax2.set_yscale('symlog'); ax2.set_ylabel('hits (excl. self)')
for bb,cc in zip(bars,counts):
    ax2.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2, cc if cc>0 else 0.3, str(cc), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('B. Foldseek 3Di-AA search of the mug151 model: zero PDB hits, 935 AFDB hits (73% named SAP30BP/HCNGP)',loc='left',fontsize=11)

ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
hres=np.array([p[0] for p in pairs]); mres=np.array([p[2] for p in pairs]); ident=np.array([p[4] for p in pairs])
isif=np.array([p[0] in iface for p in pairs])
ax3.bar(hres[~isif],np.ones((~isif).sum())*0.5,color='#cbd5e0',width=1.0)
ax3.bar(hres[isif],np.ones(isif.sum())*0.5,color='#f6ad55',width=1.0,label='SAP30BP interface with CDK11B / cyclin L2 (<4.5 A)')
ax3.bar(hres[ident],np.ones(ident.sum())*0.5,bottom=0.5,color='#2f855a',width=1.0,label='identical in mug151')
ax3.bar(hres[~ident],np.ones((~ident).sum())*0.5,bottom=0.5,color='#e2e8f0',width=1.0)
for h,label in [(159,'F$^{159}$RNP / mug151 F$^{73}$RNP'),(184,'DM$^{185}$..P / mug151 DM$^{100}$..P')]:
    ax3.annotate(label,xy=(h,1.02),xytext=(h,1.35),ha='center',fontsize=9,
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-',color='k',lw=.8))
ax3.set_ylim(0,1.7); ax3.set_yticks([0.25,0.75]); ax3.set_yticklabels(['interface','identity'])
ax3.set_xlabel('human SAP30BP residue (chain A of PDB 9QKZ, 98-215)')
ax3.legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,ncol=2,frameon=False)
ax3.set_title(f'C. Mapping the experimental SAP30BP interface onto mug151: {a}/{len(ifa)} interface positions identical '
              f'vs {c}/{len(nonifa)} elsewhere (Fisher OR={OR:.1f}, p={pv:.2f})',loc='left',fontsize=11)
plt.show()
